stance_basis: letter expresses support for operating criteria while noting inability to fully evaluate due to unavailability of referenced report
summary: David G. Talbot, Oregon State Parks Superintendent, co-signed a letter with George M. Baldwin (Administrator of Highways) expressing general support for the draft environmental statement and specifically endorsing the operating criteria recommended for adoption. However, he noted a limitation in their review: the unavailability of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle report prevented a full evaluation of the environmental statement against that report.
complaint_summary: Talbot co-signed a letter generally endorsing the draft environmental statement and emphasizing the importance of the recommended operating criteria, while noting that the unavailability of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle report limited their ability to fully evaluate the statement.

statement.text:
Thank you for the opportunity to review and comment on the environmental statement pertaining to use of off-road vehicles on the public lands. In its necessarily general way, it seems to adequately cover the expected impacts upon our environment as well as the developing difficulties that must be faced on public lands.
We feel the operating criteria recommended for adoption are especially important. Because of the unavailability of the Off-Road Recreation Vehicle report, we were unable to evaluate the environmental statement from the standpoint of the report.
Very truly yours,

George M. Baldwin

Administrator of Highways
David G. Talbot
State Parks Superintendent
